fact: UNCTAD's Seychelles National Entrepreneurship Strategy says there is no stand-alone Entrepreneurship Policy or Act and proposes only to consider introducing a Start-Up Act defining innovative start-ups.

The Business Tax (Exemption of Tax for Infant Companies) Order 2025 exempts firms in their first five years in manufacturing, the blue economy and digital sectors from business tax, from 1 January 2025 to 1 January 2030.
